top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Drift After AI-Driven Rally, Oil Prices Slip
top_signals.summary: US stock futures meandered Tuesday morning with traders holding onto big AI-fueled gains and looked for positive developments in the Middle East conflict that would lead to lower oil prices.

top_signals.title: Radiant World Sent Mizuho Fake Glencore Email, Court Filing Says
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc last month told Mizuho Bank Ltd. that it believes Radiant World fraudulently generated email correspondence purporting to show that the Switzerland-based commodities trader planned to pay back the Japanese lender nearly $100 million, according to a legal filing obtained by Bloomberg News.
